firstPlayerRule: The rulebook doesn't say how to choose roles: assign one player as the ghost and everyone else as psychics. The game begins with the ghost's turn.
clarifications: Mysterium is cooperative. During their turn, the ghost chooses which psychic to give each Vision to.
Psychics can start discussing as soon as they receive their first Vision.
With 3 players, each psychic plays two colours.
